data: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo-Quantized is a text-to-image diffusion model optimized for fast generation (10-20s for 1024x1024 on GPU) with various quantization formats (GGUF, FP8, INT8, NVFP4, MLX) for efficient deployment. It supports uncensored image generation and is compatible with ComfyUI and command-line runtimes.
